sentences.text: Mr. Narendra Jain, learned counsel for the applicant.
Mr. Vijay Soni, learned Panel Lawyer for the State.
Heard on I.A. No.23746/16 an application U/s.389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Call for the records of the trial Court as well as the appellate Court.

The applicant has been convicted for an offence U/s.7(1), 16(1)((a)(i) and 7(5), 16(1)(a)(ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for 6 months each with fine of Rs.1000/- each.

Looking to the short sentence of only three months, I am inclined to allow I.A. No.23746/16 and suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of the applicant Anand Kumar subject to his depositing the amount of fine and direct that the applicant herein shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with a surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
The applicant shall appear before the Registry of this Court on 22.3.2017 and on such other dates as may be directed in this behalf.

(ATUL SREEDHARAN) JUDGE a Anand Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 December, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120997926/
